name: Jesus Christ
summary: Born in Bethlehem, Jesus is the One an angel announced as a Saviour, Christ the Lord, and a voice from heaven called Him a beloved Son. He taught, healed and fed the crowds, was crucified, and on the third day He rose from the dead.

key_moments.title: Born and Laid in a Manger
key_moments.description: Mary gave birth to Jesus in Bethlehem and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room in the inn. An angel told shepherds that a Saviour was born, Christ the Lord, and they hurried to find Him.

key_moments.title: Baptized in the Jordan
key_moments.description: Jesus came to John at the Jordan to be baptized. As He came up out of the water, the Spirit of God came down on Him like a dove, and a voice from heaven called Him a beloved Son.

key_moments.title: Feeding Five Thousand
key_moments.description: A boy had five barley loaves and two small fish. Jesus gave thanks and shared them out until about five thousand men were full, and twelve baskets of leftovers were gathered.

key_moments.title: Crucified at Calvary
key_moments.description: Jesus was crucified between two criminals and asked the Father to forgive them. He promised one of the criminals paradise, then gave His spirit into the Father's hands and died.

key_moments.title: Risen From the Dead
key_moments.description: Early on the first day of the week, women found the stone rolled away and the body of Jesus gone. Two men in shining clothes told them He was not there but was risen, just as He had said.
